verdict.rationale: Jev publishes scattered transparency artifacts — a vendor-authored 'jaggedness' limitations page with nine documented failure modes, a models page stating data-handling policy (no training on customer data, no fine-tuning), and versioning/model-ID docs — but there is no single published model card or system card combining capabilities, training approach, systematic evaluation results, and intended use for the flagship model. Missing for 10: a dedicated model/system card document, disclosure of pretraining data/methodology, systematic benchmark evaluation results (only ad hoc cookbook accuracy numbers exist), and an explicit intended-use statement.
